# config.txt
#
# Do not have any blank lines in this file.
#
# You must define the following, otherwise default values will be used:
#
# startage, stopage, interval - these can be in whatever time units you want,
#                               although integers are advised (i.e. you might
#                               want to use months rather than fractional years)
#
# seedstring                  - For a "random" seed, i.e. one generated by the
# 								system clock, use the line:
#									 seedstring:USE_SYSTEM_CLOCK
#								Otherwise just say what you want (any string) after "seedstring:" 
#								e.g. seedstring:this is a fixed seed!
#
# initialstate				  - This must be a valid state defined in your stt.txt file
#                               e.g. initialstate:normal   
#
# number					  - This is the number of people that you wish to iterate over
#
startage:12
stopage:80
interval:2

#seedstring:USE_SYSTEM_CLOCK
number:5
